function: Channel extrapolation: learns which hybrid-RIS elements to activate and extrapolates the full BS-RIS and RIS-user channels from the activated elements (p. 2).
system: Hybrid RIS with 8x8 elements, some activated to sense; transmitter with 4 antennas, 4 single-antenna users; OFDM with 24 subcarriers at 28 GHz (p. 2, 4).
method: Graph convolutional networks: NSNet selects RIS elements, CENet (RK3 CNN plus GCN) extrapolates; Gumbel-softmax edge pruning; supervised NMSE loss, joint offline training with Adam (p. 3-4).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing O1 scenario at 28 GHz; 10,000 channel samples of F and G, split 4:1 into training and testing sets (p. 4).
test_conditions: Same DeepMIMO O1 data for training and testing (4:1 split); sweeps of node sampling rate, edge sampling rate and SNR; no new scenario (p. 4-5).
baselines: Uniform activation pattern (uni), probabilistic-sampling selection (proF), and odeCNN, the CENet without graph layers; no classical estimator curve (LS only gives the input) (p. 4-5).
metrics: NMSE in dB versus node sampling rate, edge sampling rate, and SNR (p. 4-5).
complexity: none; only a qualitative claim that edge pruning reduces computational cost; Table I lists layer sizes, no operations, parameter count or runtime (p. 1, 4).
openness: none; trains on the public DeepMIMO dataset [19], cited without a link; no code released (p. 4).
q1_support: p. 4: "The DeepMIMO dataset [19] is widely used in various DL-based works for MIMO communication systems." Channels come from its O1 ray-tracing scenario at 28 GHz.
q2_support: p. 5: "In the future, we consider to improve the generalization ability of network in different distribution datasets." Training and testing use one DeepMIMO O1 data set split 4:1 (p. 4); only SNR and sampling rates vary, nothing is tested in a new scenario.
q3_support: p. 4: "We remove the graph convolution layers to construct a full convolution layers-based extrapolation network" (odeCNN). This is an ablation of CENet; uni and proF are selection variants run inside the proposed CENet; no earlier published or classical estimator is compared.
q4_support: p. 1: "edges are pruned to reduce computational cost" is only a qualitative claim. No complexity order, FLOPs, parameter count or runtime is reported; Table I on p. 4 lists layer shapes only.
q5_support: p. 4: "The DeepMIMO dataset [19] is widely used in various DL-based works for MIMO communication systems." Public DeepMIMO O1 channels are used for training and testing; no code of its own is released.
notes: Hybrid RIS: some elements are activated to sense the channel (p. 1-2). Area 2 because the main metric is the channel NMSE and the activation pattern is a pilot/sensing pattern, not a phase-shift design. q3 is borderline: odeCNN is CENet without graph layers (ablation), proF is the probabilistic-sampling selection of [13] (cited p. 3) run inside the proposed CENet and never presented as a comparison with [13], and uni is a fixed non-learned pattern, so no explicit earlier learned baseline is compared.
